items.title: Two Peas in a pod
items.overview: Victoria is caught between three wars. One is in Israel, where she lives. Another is in Ukraine, where she was born. The third is personal: a battle with her father whose devotion to his new wife, Lena, left no room for his daughter. When Victoria learns he is gravely ill, she has no choice but to return to her Ukrainian hometown ? once peaceful, now shattered by war.

items.title: Superbuhei
items.overview: Follows a recovering alcoholic who suspects he's being stalked by his own evil twin brother who is trying to assume his identity and take over his life.

items.title: Identitti
items.overview: A student named Nivedita finds an old photo of her professor and discovers the latter had been living a lie. Saraswati, of all people — a woman of color who lectures on cultural identity — is in fact white. While the media and online community whip up a frenzy, Nivedita faces a political and personal dilemma as she tries to find out Saraswati's motive.

items.title: Never Surrender
items.overview: An ex-soldier and his grandchildren battle against ruthless criminals in a remote village. To survive, they must also confront their fears and regrets.

items.title: lmroz'da Bahar
items.overview: Spring in Imroz is an emotional film set in the enchanting atmosphere of Gökçeada (Imroz), telling the stories of two different people whose paths intersect, exploring the traces of the past and the possibility of love being reborn (a second spring). Directed by Özcan Alper, the film reunites Halit Ergenç and Meryem Uzerli after 15 years.

items.title: Blood Money
items.overview: In the Albanian port city of Durrës, Arion, a former inmate, is released from prison to fight in illegal bare-knuckle bouts at the notorious venue «The Circle» on behalf of Ilir, who is heavily in debt. Club owner Hans is initially skeptical of Arion. However, as Arion attracts more and more attention, Hans recognizes his commercial potential as well. What begins as a way out of poverty turns into a risky game when Ilir becomes involved in an illegal betting ring.

items.title: Gabin
items.overview: Gabin, the youngest child of the Jourdel family, is set to take over his father's butcher shop. Torn between family loyalty and a desire to break free, he has other dreams.

items.title: A legmagányosabb ember a városban
items.overview: Al Cook blues-zenész egy emlékekkel teli lakásban él. Odakint az élet nélküle megy tovább. Amikor azonban az otthonát bontásra ítélik, létezésének romjai közül váratlanul ismét felszínre tör egy rég elfeledett álom.

items.title: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
items.overview: “UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun” follows the world-renowned classical Chinese dance company Shen Yun Performing Arts as it rises to global acclaim while facing intimidation and threats of violence. Through the eyes of two brothers and their fellow performers, the film traces an unlikely journey—from ordinary American childhoods to the world’s most prestigious stages—where rigorous artistic training and spiritual conviction shape both their craft and their character.  As Shen Yun tours internationally, the company becomes the target of escalating smear campaigns, threats, and alleged interference linked to the Chinese Communist Party. Blending personal storytelling with investigative reporting, “UNBROKEN” reveals what happens when art, faith, and freedom collide with totalitarianism power—and how resilience, community, and cultural revival endure in the face of intimidation.

items.title: This is the House: If I Dont See You, I Love You
items.overview: A reflective portrait of a Ghanaian American father and daughter sifting through a crowded basement, uncovering long-forgotten family archives and memories.

items.title: Sound is the Body
items.overview: A Venezuelan city is emptying. A labor less priest struggles with a sonic sleep disorder while trying to safe-keep his meek buffalo from being taken. As the intentions of the remaining ones become more desperate, the priest’s malaise becomes more alive.

items.title: Victorian Psycho: A nevelőnő
items.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

items.title: Under Fire
items.overview: As a fire captain in Idaho, Rob has spent his life saving others. Now, with the help of an experimental therapy, he may just learn how to save himself.

items.title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories And Beyond
items.overview: Dr. Eggman's evil scheme is to upgrade Metal Sonic to the ultimate fighting machine. By stealing Sonic's life data and harnessing the power of the Chaos Emeralds, Sonic and his friends realize that in order to defeat Metal Sonic, they must rely on the friendship they built through their adventures!

items.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
items.overview: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek warns that PawPaw's health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.

items.title: The Christmas Yes List
items.overview: Chloe Hollis, an ambitious New York professional whose habit of putting everyone else first has left her overlooked for the promotion she desperately wants, returns home to Maple Hills, West Virginia, for Christmas. Determined to change her people-pleasing ways, Chloe embarks on an unconventional holiday challenge to overcome her fear of rejection. But when she meets James Stone, a successful executive spending Christmas with family in town, Chloe discovers some of life’s greatest gifts arrive when we stop fearing the answer and start embracing the journey.
